notes: The reference's first screen depends on a CUT-OUT portrait standing through the giant word. An ordinary photograph cannot do that; here it fills a 2:1-topped arch window that rises to the foot of the word, in front of the reference's half disc. A client who can supply a cut-out (transparent PNG/WebP of the person) would get the reference's build; the contract has no field for it yet (suggest media.photos[].cutout: true).

Pictures with lettering baked in are never put in the first screen. Rule used: the first screen takes only a portrait/people photograph, never a landscape; and any photograph whose alt names words, a caption, a sign, a logo or a quoted phrase is placed last in every choice. That catches person1 hero.jpg only because its alt says 'the words "YOU ARE HERE"'. Capture should record lettering directly (OCR on each picture → media.photos[].lettered: true, or the text it found); the template already honours a `lettered` or `text` key.
No made pictures are used (client photography only).
